name: month_end_snapshots
sql: with month_end as ( select max(dlycaldt) as rebal_dt from crsp.dsf_v2 where dlycaldt between %s and %s group by date_trunc('month', dlycaldt) ) select d.dlycaldt as rebal_dt, d.permno, d.dlycap, d.dlyprc, d.ticker, d.siccd, d.primaryexch from crsp.dsf_v2 d join month_end m on m.rebal_dt = d.dlycaldt where d.sharetype = 'NS' and d.securitytype = 'EQTY' and d.securitysubtype = 'COM' and d.usincflg = 'Y' and d.primaryexch in ('N', 'A', 'Q') and d.dlycap is not null and d.dlycap > 0 order by d.dlycaldt, d.dlycap desc, d.permno
note: 2010-01-01..2025-12-31 每月最後交易日的合格普通股與市值
